rate_correction: producer surface rates are rebuilt from component mass rates: water = Water_mass_rate/rhoWS, hydrocarbons = remaining mass split by the SurfaceWellConditions flash. JutulDarcy 0.3.7 reports wrat from the aqueous reservoir volume fraction, which gas expansion inflates (~80x at SPE5's producer).

surface_conditions.note: Explicit on every well. JutulDarcy's default is 288.15 K; ResSim uses 288.71 K for the producer flash, oil-rate control and injection densities.

tolerances.note: JutulDarcy defaults; not the ResSim 1e-8 per-cell mole balance
